_comment: When each source of the Mexican Consumer page publishes its next period, as the publishers themselves schedule it (owner, 13-Oct-2026: everything on the page updated on time, aligned with scheduled releases). Read by scripts/mx-consumidor/lib/calendar.mjs. inegi: the dates come from INEGI's own release calendar PDFs, read on every refresh (fetch.mjs -> raw/calendar.json; the reader also tries cal_<this year>.pdf and cal_<next year>.pdf); `files` lists any other calendar file INEGI publishes (a second-half calendar, a calendar of changes): the daily task adds it when a source below runs out of future dates (pending.mjs -> calendarGaps). Each source names the product exactly as the calendar prints it and its periodicity. banxico: the rule or the dates each release's own page states, quoted verbatim with the day it was read; re-read them when a date is missed. bis: the 'Next release date' the BIS prints on its topic page (read on every refresh, raw/bis.json). editions: surveys whose next edition is not in any calendar yet. companies: reporting deadlines (BMV list of dates for 2026; the rule of the Circular Única de Emisoras after that; SEC 10-Q / 10-K deadlines for U.S. domestic filers). graceBankingDays: banking days after the scheduled date before the page marks a source as late (1 by default: the page reads INEGI's 06:00 and Banco de México's 09:00 releases the same morning; a series read through another publisher's mirror gets more).

enoe.product: Encuesta Nacional de Ocupación y Empleo

consumption.via: read through Banco de México's SIE, which republishes INEGI's series

wages.product: Índices Globales de Personal y Remuneraciones de los Sectores Económicos
wages.note: the block's period is the older of INEGI's average real pay index (this product) and Banco de México's real minimum wage, which follows the INPC and is always ahead

remittances.quote: se publica el primer día hábil bancario del mes a las 9:00 horas.
remittances.checked: the rule gives the six publication dates the page lists, 4-May to 1-Oct-2026

bankCredit.quote: Se publica el último día hábil bancario de cada mes a las 9:00 horas.
bankCredit.checked: the release (Agregados monetarios y actividad financiera) carries commercial banks' performing consumer credit by product in its Cuadro 5 (report of March 2026, published 30-Apr-2026); the block's period is that of the performing portfolio (CF835)

savings.quote: Se publica el último día hábil bancario de cada mes a las 9:00 horas.
savings.checked: the rule gives the six publication dates the page lists, 30-Apr to 30-Sep-2026

lending.quote: En 2026, los resultados de la EnBan estarán disponibles los días 6 de febrero, 8 de mayo, 7 de agosto y 6 de noviembre a las 14:00 horas.

enigh.note: every two years; the 2026 edition is not in INEGI's calendars yet

poverty.note: every two years, with the ENIGH; not in INEGI's calendars yet

enif.note: the next edition is not in INEGI's calendars yet
